paired_background.role_contract: A0_ON writes C+N; A0/A1 OFF and TO plus A1 ON reuse identical background

ON.definition: candidate is Known Physical Correction; reference is paired A0 input after four-channel protocol fusion

known_correction_physical_closure.definition: A0 versus evaluator-only known-correction F1/F2, relative complex RMS <= 1e-3

metrics.target_detection_definition: one target detection opportunity per visible truth period; hit if any production detection record matches that period's target

metrics.cluster_false_alarm_definition: selected CFAR clusters minus one target-associated cluster per matched target period

csi_h0_active_support.definition: H0-only CSI residual on exported active support; uses csi_after complex map, not detector-input union after_power

definitions.paired_complex_transfer: least-squares complex gain mapping CSI(TO) to CSI(ON)-CSI(OFF) in truth-centered 5x5 ROIs; CSI adapts per role, so this is a paired transfer diagnostic, not a fixed linear-system gain
definitions.output_scnr_proxy_db: 10log10(mean CSI(TO) target-ROI power / mean CSI(OFF) same-ROI C+N power)
definitions.target_only_csi_retention_db: 10log10(CSI output power / before-CSI equalized power) for TO target ROI; negative values indicate target attenuation
